scope: All model providers and model families

qualifying_failures: malformed or truncated provider envelope before a model completion
completed response that violates the shared schema or local contract
invalid generated references, counts, or enumerated values
compiler critique that changes generated semantic content

forbidden: model-specific prompt, schema, validator, weight, or retry-budget changes
editing a hidden item after observing a target-model result
report_separately: transport attempts and final infrastructure status
semantic repair count and failed node
exact requested and response model identifiers
registration_note: This policy was frozen after the current Gemini and GPT world-generation calls had begun. It is a uniform retrospective rescoring rule for the 2026-08-25 suite and a prospective frozen rule for later community/runtime calls. A new hidden generation suite must commit this policy before any target-model call to support a preregistered claim.
